load_video_frames_random: load frames from a video file using random sampling and return a normalized PyTorch tensor
load_video_frames_uniform: load frames from a video file using uniform sampling and return a normalized PyTorch tensor
extract_frames_to_tensor: extract a specified number of frames from a video path and convert them to a PyTorch tensor
review_load_frames_from_video_path: review the load_frames_from_video_path function that samples frames from a video using OpenCV and returns tensors
refactor_load_frames_from_video_path: refactor load_frames_from_video_path to support additional sampling strategies beyond rand and uniform
